title: Graph revision reducer decomposition
description: Objective: reduce the graph-revision reducer below the permanent file-size cap by extracting result/error/state-clone responsibility. Deliverable: focused packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-results.ts plus a <=250-line graph-revision-reducer.ts that preserves reduceGraphRevision, command/transition exports, rejection precedence, stable codes, event/version ordering, and frozen results. Hard dependency: commit bcdc2f6. NOT in scope: contract changes, new transitions, graph mutation rules, planning-run changes, or test rewrites. Owned paths: packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-reducer.ts and packages/core/src/planning/graph-revision-results.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: reduceGraphRevision and GRAPH_REVISION_COMMAND_KINDS/GRAPH_REVISION_TRANSITIONS retain their existing signatures and observable values.
Stable errors, check precedence, compound version accounting, zero-state-change rejection, events, and deep-frozen results are unchanged.
Both production modules are <=250 physical lines and each has one named responsibility.
Existing graph hostile, lifecycle, concurrency, and invariant tests pass unchanged and the focused gate exits 0.
taskRails: Refactor-only: preserve public types, stable error codes, check precedence, event/result ordering, deep freezing, and all observable reducer behavior.
Do not weaken, skip, rename, or delete behavioral assertions merely to make the split pass.
Every changed or new production/test TypeScript file in this task must be <=250 physical lines with LF/CRLF counted equivalently.
Use TDD/characterization and commit only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, merge, reset, or stash.
